leads.reason: Two posts of Nov 17 (12:03-12:04 UTC) discuss the reported horse death as a news event; the rest are call-group shills. Pools opened under an hour ago, after the story, so launched on it.
leads.title: Justice For So You Are (Melbourne Cup horse) coins
leads.sourceSays: Posts say a Melbourne Cup horse, So You Are, was found dead in a Sydney skip bin and the news went viral today, citing CNN and Sky Sports; another post reacts to it. Unverified here.

sources.author: Silvlaia
sources.text:
$SOYOUARE — Justice For So You Are

Melbourne Cup horse found dead in a Sydney skip bin, viral today (CNN, Sky Sports). Launched ±18:02 WIB, +1,151% in 1H, now ±$28.6K MCAP on PumpSwap.

leads.reason: Daily review: Hourly scout lead (confirmed), re-checked with today's $BAWSAQ search (e2:0): BAWSAQ is the fictional stock exchange of the Grand Theft Auto games, and the coins name GTA VI or Vice City, so this is the GTA 6 launch story, not a new one. Joined GTA 6 launch coins: Vice City Index (Pump.fun 4La95N..., $5,311,028; description "BAWSAQ is the GTA VI stock index on Solana"), Vice City Bawsaq (D9EcoQ..., $2,199,373) and the Meteora DBC Vice City Index (C42Ghr..., $1,806,826). bawsaq.pro (bawsYv...) is under the $100K market-cap bar ($59,503). An older Bawsaq coin (7dzdHo...) was already a member.

leads.reason: Nearly all posts are call-group entry/multiple shills with the contract address. Two posts compare $Rex and $Gekko and mention GeckoTerminal, and the on-chain description says CoinGecko mascot, but no post explains a story or origin; the coin may be tied to CoinGecko's mascot but nothing here confirms it.
Nearly all posts are call-group entry/multiple shills; only one thin post claims Elon tweeted $Katia (SpaceX-themed 'spacex-chan'), with a different contract and no source. Re-check later.
Posts of Nov 16 are call-group contract-address shills with entry and multiple claims; the only substantive $BANK posts (Lorenzo Protocol in September, BankFi) concern unrelated older projects.

Daily review: The word "fund" joins unrelated coins: Vice City Index (GTA, assigned to GTA 6 launch coins), Emotional Trauma Fund (a joke fund; its own account and call posts only, e2:1) and American Sovereign Wealth Fund (says it is the official token of an American sovereign wealth fund; the e3:0 search found call posts and one unsourced post about an executive order, no official source naming the coin). The dividend- and oil-fund coins (UODF, USOE, UDTF, AODF, USOI, XTO) are quarantined. Fewer than three qualifying coins share a story with an independent source.

Daily review: A generic word ("built on Solana", "Built for the players") shared by unrelated coins: Emotional Trauma Fund, Leonida Games (a GTA VI coin, added to GTA 6 launch coins on its own metadata), American Sovereign Wealth Fund and COGE. No common story.
Posts are call-group and bot alerts (CA, multiples, DexScreener updates) plus an unrelated $JOJO bond ETF account; no story behind The Nietzschean Gorilla launch.
Posts are CA shills, call-group entry/multiple posts, Bags fee-claim bots and hopes of an Elon repost; one post calls it a scam. Several same-name tickers, no event, person or product behind it.

Daily review: Hourly scout lead (deferred), re-evaluated: the Attack Inu coins are not in today's sweep, and an "Attack Inu" search (e3:1) returned unrelated posts (Shiba Inu art, an Initia hack) and no event. cyber attack (Q1vecE...) has an empty description and Cyber Security Inu is under the bar.
All 19 posts are contract-address shills and call-group 'Nx from my call' posts for one ticker; none describes an event, person or product behind the word.
COGE posts are copy-pasted 1000x shills with the contract address, plus scam alerts about wallet clustering; the GTAVI 'Here We Go Again' coins have no posts. No story behind the word.
Posts are call-group multiples, CTO pings and buy shills for a $CYBER contract, plus old CyberConnect token posts from 2023; no event or story behind the word.
